subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` config key for lane wait diagnostics, and should it hot-apply or be restart-only?
rationale: This adds a new public config surface, so automation should not decide the permanent key name or reload contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after it aligns schema, types, help/reference docs, and reload planning while preserving the current default and explicit overrides.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the config key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising config-reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Leave the threshold fixed or solve the log-noise problem through another diagnostics policy and close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after it aligns schema, types, help/reference docs, and reload planning while preserving the current default and explicit overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: He has both feature-history context for the queue and prior item-specific review guidance on the desired config/docs/test shape.
